hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for DCA pools that enforces dynamic fees based on user type (internal 0%, keeper 0.10%, external 0.50%), restricts swaps to admin-approved routers via an allowlist, and distributes SuperDCA token rewards 50/50 between LPs (via pool donations) and a developer address during liquidity operations and external swaps.
